title: Attribution Completed
description: attribution-completed/v1 — the pledging side declaring that it has posted everything it will post against an approved list. It does two things and neither of them is evidence of delivery: it tells the valuation engine that the round is finished, so evaluation runs now rather than when the deadline passes, and it CLOSES the approval it cites, so a later posting needs a fresh proposal rather than riding consent already given. What was actually delivered is read from the receipts, never from this document.

reportId.description: The report whose attribution round is finished.

proposalId.description: The approved proposal this round executed. The event also references the approval event itself, which is what closes it.

by.description: The emitting ORGANIZATION. Agreement events carry a role rather than an org, so the document pins the organization.
